package.name: g1_hands
package.description: ROS 1 (Noetic) drivers for the BrainCo Revo2 tactile dexterous hands on the Unitree G1 humanoid (trimmed teaching build). Each hand runs as its own node over its own USB / RS-485 Modbus bus and exposes pre-grasp, 5-finger grasp, release, point-gesture and berry-gesture Trigger services plus a per-hand TactileStatus publisher. The tactile auto-release monitor is removed in this build.
